declared.title: Does mental contrasting with implementation intentions (MCII) help to increase physical activity?
declared.foundIn: reports/choose-your-struggle/counter-evidence.md (card 11); Crossref search « Kędra Łaguna MCII online intervention randomized Current Issues in Personality Psychology » (2026-11-26)

population: two online trials with physically active people: 59 students aiming to walk more, 112 gym-goers aiming at more aerobic training

findings.text: An online MCII exercise did not change physical activity, self-efficacy or engagement over two weeks, in either trial

support.sentence: No statistically significant effects of the MCII online intervention were observed in either Study 1 or Study 2.

limits: small samples (59 and 112), two weeks of follow-up
people already active: little room to improve
the control group's task and the country are not given in the abstract
no sample from the Middle East or North Africa known
